usg.text: Barrin takes his name when the ink runs as he signs out, and Urza enlists him as headmaster so that the two found the Tolarian Academy around 3285 AR.
His progress report calls Teferi a problem student, but Urza urges him to be patient because a prize student cannot be replaced.

Urza and Barrin create Karn as a time-travel probe, and when Kerrick attacks Tolaria after getting the time machine plans, Karn is sent back in time to stop him, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster that destroys the Academy.
Urza, Barrin and Karn return to Tolaria and reestablish the Academy with Jhoira's aid.

ulg.text: Kerrick launches the Invasion of Tolaria while Urza is away, so Barrin activates a beacon and Urza returns to destroy Kerrick.
Barrin saves Urza, and Multani, who becomes trapped within Urza, later helps destroy Kerrick and his Negators.
When Urza creates the Metathran army, Barrin contests his methods and researchers quit, and he warns Urza that he cannot possibly know the toll his alliances will exact.
Barrin also weds Rayne, then realizes that Urza chose her as his mate for the Bloodlines.

uds.text: Barrin drowns his doubts about Urza's project in its details, though he doubts Urza's sanity.
Urza appoints Rayne chancellor to push her and Barrin into producing an offspring.
Barrin contests the Metathran army's creation as researchers quit, and he and Rayne find a Capashen blood sample the negator took, revealing that a big attack on Benalia is imminent.
In Urza's invasion of Serra's Realm, Barrin battles the Phyrexian overlord.

pcy.text: Teferi sends Barrin to reorganize the League, working with Mageta, Rayne and Jolrael.
Barrin and Teferi destroy Latulla's banished followers, and Barrin decapitates Latulla when she is pinned under a war barge, having mistaken him for a slave.
Embittered Barrin and shaken Teferi turn away from Urza's plan.

m21.text: Barrin appears on the set's cards as a Tolarian archmage.
